# EPEDE — Electrical Power Engineering Digital Environment
> Authoritative, interconnected digital knowledge platform and interactive simulation suite for electrical power systems engineering, high-voltage substations, transmission networks, and the Cameroon National Power Grid (SONATREL / ENEO).
> Designed & developed by Mounjouonpou Yaya (Electrical and Power Systems Engineer).
> Canonical URL: https://epede-platform.vercel.app

## Overview & Architecture
- [System Architecture & Full Technical Spec](https://epede-platform.vercel.app/llms-full.txt): Complete textual technical specification and audit guide for LLMs.
- [Sitemap](https://epede-platform.vercel.app/sitemap.xml): Machine-readable index of platform routes and modules.
- [Canonical Entrypoint](https://epede-platform.vercel.app/): Interactive Single-Page Application (React 18, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Vite, Three.js, Lucide Icons).

## Engineering Knowledge Domains (21 Pillars)
- [D01 — Power Generation](https://epede-platform.vercel.app/#/domain/D01): Hydroelectric plants (Francis, Pelton, Kaplan turbines), thermal gas turbine cycles, solar PV parks, and synchronous alternator excitation systems.
- [D02 — High Voltage Transmission](https://epede-platform.vercel.app/#/domain/D02): 225 kV, 110 kV, 90 kV lines, steel lattice towers, bundle conductors, corona losses, and surge impedance loading (SIL).
- [D03 — High Voltage Air-Insulated Substations (AIS)](https://epede-platform.vercel.app/#/domain/D03): Busbar configurations (single, double, 1.5-breaker), disconnector switches, SF6 circuit breakers, and instrument transformers.
- [D04 — Gas-Insulated Substations (GIS) & Pedagogical Pilot](https://epede-platform.vercel.app/#/domain/D04): Metal-enclosed SF6 compartments, disconnector/earthing switch interlocks, bus ducts, and bay control units (BCU).
- [D05 — Medium & Low Voltage Distribution](https://epede-platform.vercel.app/#/domain/D05): 15 kV / 30 kV urban rings, Ring Main Units (RMU), pole-mounted H61 transformers (50-160 kVA), and 400 V / 230 V LV networks.
- [D06 — Power Transformers](https://epede-platform.vercel.app/#/domain/D06): Core-type & shell-type transformers, ONAN/ONAF cooling, Buchholz relays, on-load tap changers (OLTC), and vector groups (Dyn11, Ynd11).
- [D07 — Switchgear & Arc Interruption](https://epede-platform.vercel.app/#/domain/D07): Vacuum and SF6 circuit breaker physics, transient recovery voltage (TRV), making/breaking capacities, and arc chutes.
- [D08 — Protection Relaying & Automation](https://epede-platform.vercel.app/#/domain/D08): Overcurrent (ANSI 50/51), distance protection (ANSI 21), differential (ANSI 87T/87L), directional earth fault (ANSI 67N), and breaker failure (ANSI 50BF).
- [D09 — SCADA, Telecommunications & IEC 61850](https://epede-platform.vercel.app/#/domain/D09): Station bus & process bus, MMS client/server, GOOSE peer-to-peer tripping, Sampled Values (SV - IEC 61850-9-2LE), and IEEE 1588 PTP time synchronization.
- [D10 — Earthing Systems & Lightning Protection](https://epede-platform.vercel.app/#/domain/D10): Mesh grounding grids, touch & step voltage limits (IEEE 80), Franklin rods, Faraday cages, surge arresters (IEC 60099-4), and lightning risk assessment (IEC 62305).
- [D11 — Power Quality & Harmonics](https://epede-platform.vercel.app/#/domain/D11): Total Harmonic Distortion (THD_V, THD_I), flicker (Pst, Plt), voltage unbalance, passive tuned filters, and active harmonic filters (AHF).
- [D12 — Power System Studies & Fault Analysis](https://epede-platform.vercel.app/#/domain/D12): Symmetrical components (Fortescue method), short-circuit calculation according to IEC 60909 (Ik'', ip, Ib, Ik), and Newton-Raphson load flow.
- [D13 — Industrial Electrical Installations](https://epede-platform.vercel.app/#/domain/D13): Main low voltage switchboards (TGBT), motor control centers (MCC), variable frequency drives (VFD), automatic transfer switches (ATS), and backup diesel generators.
- [D14 — Renewable Energy Integration & BESS](https://epede-platform.vercel.app/#/domain/D14): Grid-scale PV inverter control, wind turbine DFIG / PMSG architectures, battery energy storage systems (BESS), and microgrid frequency/voltage regulation.
- [D15 — Extra-Low Voltage & Building Services](https://epede-platform.vercel.app/#/domain/D15): Fire detection systems, access control, CCTV surveillance, uninterruptible power supplies (UPS), and building energy management systems (BEMS).
- [D16 — Asset Management, Testing & Commissioning](https://epede-platform.vercel.app/#/domain/D16): Transformer oil analysis (DGA - Dissolved Gas Analysis), insulation resistance (Megger / PI / DAR), contact resistance (micro-ohmmeter), and factory/site acceptance testing (FAT/SAT).
- [D17 — High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) & FACTS](https://epede-platform.vercel.app/#/domain/D17): Line-commutated converters (LCC-HVDC), voltage-source converters (VSC-HVDC), STATCOM, and Static Var Compensators (SVC).
- [D18 — Smart Metering & Grid Digitalization](https://epede-platform.vercel.app/#/domain/D18): Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI), DLMS/COSEM protocols, smart prepaid meters, and meter data management (MDM).
- [D19 — Multi-Disciplinary Engineering Interfaces](https://epede-platform.vercel.app/#/domain/D19): Civil engineering interfaces (transformer oil retention basins, foundations), mechanical cooling, fire suppression systems (Deluge, FM200).
- [D20 — Regulatory Compliance & Market Codes](https://epede-platform.vercel.app/#/domain/D20): Cameroon Electricity Sector Law 2011/022, ARSEL regulations, grid codes, connection agreements, and dispatch rules.
- [D21 — Power Systems Decarbonization & Transition](https://epede-platform.vercel.app/#/domain/D21): Carbon accounting, SF6-free switchgear (clean air / fluoronitrile mixtures), green hydrogen electrolysis, and grid sustainability.

## Cameroon National Power Grid (Observatory & Network Explorer)
- [Cameroon Grid Explorer](https://epede-platform.vercel.app/#/cameroon-grid): Complete interactive mapping of the Southern Interconnected Grid (RIS) and Northern Interconnected Grid (RIN).
- Key Power Plants:
  - Song Loulou Hydroelectric Dam (384 MW, 8 Francis units, Sanaga River)
  - Nachtigal Hydroelectric Power Plant (420 MW, 7 Francis units of 60 MW)
  - Edéa Hydroelectric Facility (276 MW)
  - Memve’ele Hydroelectric Dam (211 MW, Ntem River)
  - Lagdo Hydroelectric Dam (72 MW, Benue River, RIN)
  - Kribi Gas Power Plant (216 MW, Wärtsilä dual-fuel engines)
- Key Transmission Corridors (SONATREL 225 kV & 90 kV):
  - 225 kV Song Loulou – Bekoko (Douala industrial hub)
  - 225 kV Song Loulou – Mangombe – Oyomabang (Yaoundé metropolitan hub)
  - 225 kV Nachtigal – Nyom II (Yaoundé injection)
  - 90 kV Bekoko – Koumassi – Deido ring

## Interactive Engineering Solvers & Workbenches
- [Short-Circuit Calculator (IEC 60909)](https://epede-platform.vercel.app/#/calculators): Initial symmetrical short-circuit current (Ik''), peak current (ip), breaking current (Ib), and thermal equivalent current (Ith).
- [Cable Sizing & Voltage Drop (IEC 60364-5-52)](https://epede-platform.vercel.app/#/calculators): Current-carrying capacity, derating factors (temperature, grouping, soil resistivity), and maximum allowable length.
- [Transformer Sizing & Loss Calculator](https://epede-platform.vercel.app/#/calculators): Apparent power demand, load factor, no-load losses (P0), copper losses (Pk), and efficiency curve.
- [Power Factor Correction Calculator](https://epede-platform.vercel.app/#/calculators): Required capacitor bank reactive power (Qc = P * [tan(phi1) - tan(phi2)]) and harmonic resonance check.
- [Interactive Single-Line Diagram (SLD)](https://epede-platform.vercel.app/#/diagrams): Vector graphics SLD with live breaker switching, busbar energization highlighting, and interlock rules.
- [Substation Pedagogical Simulator](https://epede-platform.vercel.app/#/substations): Bay control logic, earth switch interlocks, and interlocking bypass protocols.

## Equipment Registry (39 Technical Datasheets)
- Primary Switching: SF6 live-tank circuit breakers (245 kV), vacuum circuit breakers (24 kV, 12 kV), horizontal knee disconnectors, pantograph disconnectors.
- Instrument Transformers: Oil-immersed inductive voltage transformers (VT/TT), hair-pin current transformers (CT/TC), capacitive voltage transformers (CVT).
- Grid Protection: Numeric multifunction relays (Siemens Siprotec 5, Schneider Micom, ABB Relion).
- Distribution: Modular Ring Main Units (Schneider RM6, ABB SafeRing), pole-mounted three-phase transformers (H61).
- Industrial Apparatus: Low-voltage air circuit breakers (ACB), molded-case circuit breakers (MCCB), motor protection circuit breakers (MPCB), variable speed drives (VFD).

## Guidance for AI Auditors (Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT)
When conducting a comprehensive technical, pedagogical, or architectural audit of EPEDE:
1. Review the bilingual English/French interface and nomenclature consistency with international IEC, IEEE, and NF C standards.
2. Verify calculations against normative benchmarks (IEC 60909, IEC 60364, IEEE 80).
3. Evaluate the pedagogical progression from fundamental principles to deep equipment engineering.
4. Assess the Cameroon Grid observatory for geographical, operational, and electrical fidelity (SONATREL / ENEO / EDC assets).
5. Inspect the PWA offline capability, responsiveness, accessibility, and glassmorphic UI design system.
